rows.note: Use this for the everyday activity of fortune-telling about a person's future.

example.english: My mum told me to go for divination today to see whether things will go well in the second half of the year.
example.traditional: 我阿媽叫我今日去算命，睇吓下半年行唔行運。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 syun3 meng6 tai2 haa2 haa6 bun3 nin4 haang4 m4 haang4 wan6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for divination, especially in formal or general discussions.

example.english: People in ancient times used turtle shells for divination to predict whether a battle would be auspicious or disastrous.
example.traditional: 古人會用龜甲占卜，預測戰事吉凶。
example.jyutping: gu2 jan4 wui6 jung6 gwai1 gaap3 zim1 buk1 jyu6 cak1 zin3 si6 gat1 hung1
